name: External Post Trade Equity 1 Code
definition: Information related to the post trade of equities.

ALGO.name: Algorithmic Transaction
ALGO.definition: Flag for transactions executed as a result of an investment firm engaging in  algorithmic trading

AMND.name: Amendment
AMND.definition: Flag when a previously published transaction is amended.

BENC.name: Benchmark Transaction
BENC.definition: Flag for transactions executed in reference to a price that is calculated over |multiple time instances according to a given benchmark.

CANC.name: Cancellation
CANC.definition: Flag when a previously published transaction is cancelled.

CONT.name: Contingent Transaction
CONT.definition: Flag for transactions that are contingent on the purchase, sale, creation or redemption of a derivative contract or other financial instrument where all the components of the trade are meant to be executed as a single lot.

OILQ.name: Negotiated Transaction In Illiquid Financial Instruments
OILQ.definition: Flag for transactions in an illiquid instrument traded at a system-set percentage of a reference price.

NLIQ.name: Negotiated Transaction In Liquid Financial Instruments
NLIQ.definition: Flag for transactions made within the current volume weighted spread reflected on the order book or the quotes of the market makers of the trading venue operating that system.

PRIC.name: Negotiated Transaction Subject To Conditions Other Than The Current Market Price
PRIC.definition: Flag for transactions executed subject to conditions other than the current market price of that financial instrument.

PORT.name: Portfolio Transaction
PORT.definition: Flag for transactions in five or more different financial instruments where those transactions are traded at the same time by the same client.||It is used as a single lot price and that is not a ‘package transaction'.

LRGS.name: Post Trade LIS Transaction
LRGS.definition: Flag for transactions large in scale relative to normal market size, executed under a permitted post-trade deferral.

RFPT.name: Reference Price Transaction
RFPT.definition: Flag for transactions which are executed under systems.

SDIV.name: Special Dividend Transaction
SDIV.definition: Flag for transactions where dividends accrue to the non-entitled party due to ex- or cum-dividend timing.
